item.title: TfL advert showing black man harassing white woman on bus is banned over 'negative racial stereotypes'

item.title: Ukraine wipes out entire month of Russian gains in just FIVE DAYS - fastest pace in nearly three years of fighting
item.description: Ukraine has wiped out an entire month of Russian advances in just five days, its fastest pace of attack in nearly three years.The country gained 78 square miles in five days between Wednesday and Sunday, equivalent to Russia's gains for the month of December.This is based on a recent analysis of data from the Institute for the Study of War (ISW).The surge in gains followed Elon Musk's Starlink locking out illegal Russian users, hampering Moscow's military communications. item.title: Nancy Guthrie hunt suffers major setback as DNA expert reveals 'biggest question' in case
item.description: The hunt for Nancy Guthrie has suffered a major setback - more than 18 days after she disappeared.A glove, found two miles from 84-year-old Nancy's Tuscon, Arizona, home, failed to match DNA found within her home.Pima County Sheriff Chris Nanos offered no new leads as police failed to make a match in a national crime database.The glove, found on Sunday, was thought to be the best piece of evidence in the ongoing search for breakfast show host Savannah Guthrie's mother.
